content.text:
TransPerfect DataForce is an AI-training program (Recorded data-collection studies): remote contract work on AI for health professionals, not patient care.
Recorded clinical roleplay studies for medical students, paid by the hour.
DataForce by TransPerfect runs a global contributor community that collects, annotates and rates the data AI is trained on. Its clinical AI work is recorded roleplay: in October 2026 it recruited medical students in Barcelona to play the doctor in simulated doctor-patient conversations for an audio data-collection project, at $40/hr for one three-hour session. Its registered nurse openings support those studies (participant screening and safety monitoring) rather than AI work, so this directory does not list them.
4 open jobs right now, by kind of job: AI training 4.
TransPerfect DataForce, posted pay on its open jobs: typical $60/hr, median $60/hr (from 3 distinct posted hourly rates; 1 of the 4 open jobs post no hourly rate).
Pay by kind of job: AI training typical $60/hr, median $60/hr.
Payout: By wire transfer, PayPal, check, gift card or Western Union depending on location; on-site studies are paid after the study, remote projects after a quality check that varies by project.
Reputation: Part of TransPerfect, a large language and AI-services company, with a contributor community of over 1.3 million. Contributors praise the flexibility and criticize rejection rates and slow payments.
Ratings: Trustpilot 3.6 out of 5 (141 reviews, October 2026)
